API FOR run.py PREFLIGHT (go_function.withholding): Spec(aspect, regime, rule in W2|W1|WDGZrel|W2drop|all, pack, k, draw).name; RegimeData; Propagator(regime, vocab, aspect, anc, dgz) with implies/cols/t_cols/dstar_cols/strict_ancestor_cols; TargetInfo; pack_target_infos(table, pack); make_condition(spec, rd, prop, infos, P_tp=, P_dgz=) -> Condition(labels, mask, check, stats); CheckInput. Assertions assertion_1(ci), assertion_2(ci), assertion_3(ci), assertion_4(cond_manifest, base_manifest), assertion_5(ci), assertion_6(ci, base_labels_sha), assertion_7(ci, w2_labels_sha), assertion_8(ci, vocab), assertion_9(ci), assertion_10(ci). run_assertions(ci, vocab, *, base_labels_sha, w2_labels_sha=None, cond_manifest=None, base_manifest=None) -> list of assertion numbers run. All raise WithholdingAssertion (FatalError, exit 2) with counts only. Also load_condition_files(dir) -> (labels, mask pairs, manifest); check_input_from_files(dir, spec, rd, prop, infos, P_tp=, P_dgz=); replace_rows; full_column_mask; condition_files; validation_files. train_mask.npz members: 'pairs' (n,2) int32 sorted by (row, col), 'shape'. train_labels.npz: CSR prefix 'train' (pins.load_csr). The manifest has targets, retained_rows, n_withheld, n_retained, mask_count, label/mask hashes, base {label_manifest_sha256, train/valid/test_labels_sha256}, validation_mask_sha256, target_table_sha256, stats, assertions_passed, closed_world; W2drop adds w2_reference; WDGZrel adds zero_vs_prop_disagreement; TPnoIPI adds noipi_targets_kept/dropped. go_function.targets: build_table, accept_round_robin, pack_targets, placement_order, target_set_sha256, alt_excluded, ld_flag, tp_closure_counts, channel_sets, retention_order, seed_for, summary_counts.

NOTES: (1) TPnoIPI conditions drop targets with noipi.kept == false (n_train < 30 or n_test < 10 on TPnoIPI labels); the count is in each manifest. (2) The 'all' condition lives at <regime>/all/ (no pack/k). (3) The generator recomputes each withheld row from the stored A_rho. It fails fatally unless that reproduces the base row, before erasing. (4) FEAT-004 must make the trainer allocate no mask tensor when train_mask.npz has 0 pairs, and add the trainer closed-world mask test (orchestrator requirement; not in FEAT-003's scope).
